publication_incident.observation: Source validation holds the season advisory lock while validating the approved winner; supervisor renewal also requested that lock and exhausted its separate renewal budget.
publication_incident.evidence: Bounded PostgreSQL advisory-lock observations plus the diagnostic supervisor's goroutine dump identify CheckSourceOperatorHandoff -> validateSourceAuthorizationInTx. A standalone complete authorization check succeeded in 10826ms.
publication_incident.fix: Renew only under the existing exact lease-row lock, preserving owner/fence/expiry checks and guarded update. Acquirers and source writers retain their season serialization; renewal never takes season after row.
publication_incident.test_services: Fresh owner-labelled disposable PostgreSQL/Redis, removed after tests using exact verified IDs; existing local and gate services preserved
